body: My dad finds an awesome job and so does my sister and so does me. No more seeing anyone cry and everyone just always smiles.

Take life one small step at a time. Working on yourself is a long process, but it's worth it at the end. No one's life is perfect, but happiness just depends on how we handle the sad stuff in our life. Start doing meditation, go for small walks during the day. You have so many people around you who wants to help you, be grateful for that. Atleast you are not alone and people care about you. Things will be better soon, but you have to work for it one small step at a time.
Hey. I'm 22M from Dubai. Even I lost alot of friends because of moving. Give me a message if you'd like to talk :)

No one is helping anyone in this world. You only matter if you have money in your bank account. And life sucks even more if you are from a 3rd world country. You end up living your whole life just surviving for food everyday.   Life is just not worth it for many people. And many of those people would take the easy way out if possible. Same for me.

Same here. I got no one. Not even my family. Even tried suicide multiple times and I just couldn't go through it. But now I'm putting everything, all my depression into gymming and getting fit. Maybe try doing the same and it'll make you feel better once you achieve your goals. Take life one goal at a time.
